items.transkript: Good morning. Good morning to the beautiful people of this beautiful country. Welcome, before the crows even have their breakfast. We are on the final day of the week. Today is Friday, November 27th, and it has been another very fast, very busy week. We are leaving this week behind. But the agenda is still very tight. There are so many topics to discuss on this last day of the week. But let's start with sports first, let's start with football. Because football is never just football. Beşiktaş had a match yesterday and faced the Israeli team Hapoel Be'er Sheva, but since it was an Israeli team, the match wasn't played in Turkey. It was actually a match that should have been played and hosted in Turkey. But due to Israel's massacres and barbarism, and the claim that security could not be ensured here, the match was played in Batumi, Georgia, where Beşiktaş fans rightfully voiced their opposition to Israel's barbarism. They stood in solidarity with Palestine . They waved Palestinian flags. They held up Palestinian banners, and look, these scenes occurred. Police in Georgia attacked the Beşiktaş fans who were waving Palestinian flags. They even used pepper spray. So, calling murderers murderers and barbarians barbarians has become a crime . And this disgrace took place. Footage emerged of the Georgian police using pepper spray, punching, and applying disproportionate violence against Beşiktaş fans, and because of this, the match was almost halted. It stopped for half an hour. After things calmed down, the match continued . But looking at these scenes, they were subjected to this treatment for reminding barbarians that they are barbarians, for standing in solidarity with Palestine, and for raising their voices as citizens of this country against this barbarism—against the massacre of babies and the starvation of children. Now, another thought comes to mind here , look, I’m going to underscore this. Is the Georgian police perhaps thinking something like this? "Their own police are constantly pepper-spraying and beating these Turks anyway." Are they thinking that it’s acceptable for them to do it too? Are we that worthless? Now, when it comes to reacting, everyone is reacting. Statements, justified statements, justified reactions; the clubs have come together. Statements from the Ministry of Interior, the Ministry of Justice, from all institutions. I wish you had this same sensitivity when the police are beating people and choking them with pepper spray here at home. Let me say that first. That needs to be said. Let's keep that in mind. But the harshest reaction from this country must also be directed at those who committed this act, who carried out this treatment . Those who commit this barbarism should be in a position where they cannot show their faces in public. They should not be allowed in public, and they should have no place in this tournament. If such barbarism is being committed, if a country is responsible for such barbarism, how can we ignore it—just as Russian teams are banned from tournaments due to Ukraine? Are those in Palestine not human beings ? Will there be no international sanctions against the perpetrators of this barbarism that is taking place before the eyes of the entire world? There won't be. And so our fans will face such violence. Now, today is an important day again. Because today, look, the first trial in the fund scandal begins. You know, it is the world's biggest robbery, the world's biggest corruption , the biggest corruption in history, the biggest robbery in history. The biggest robbery. We are talking about human history. We say there is no such swindle, no such robbery. We have been talking about this for months. And the first trial of this fund scandal , this fund swindle, will be heard today . No. Not Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya. Not "Fonzi" Fatma. Eren just brought it to the screen. Not the swindlers. Those who smuggled billions of dollars, tens of billions of dollars abroad are not the ones being tried first. The first ones to be tried are the journalists you see on the screen. Şaban Sevinç and Mustafa Balbay. They are appearing before the judge today. And why? Look, here is the reason. Because they reported on the fund scandal. Because they explained the fund scandal . "Fonzi" Fatma is at her home. She is at her home with the news. She watches in her lavish life, in her fancy home, from her very expensive sofa on her ultra-large screen television. She watches the hearing. Because she is at her home. The journalists are in prison. The journalists are in prison. As I said, there is no trial yet for the others. But they are asking for 18 years and 10 months for Şaban Sevinç. They are asking for 10 years of imprisonment for Mustafa Balbay. They have been in prison for nearly 2 months. It has been almost 2 months. And their crimes are very big. Very big . They did not steal money from the people's pockets. They didn't get into funds and rake in billions. They didn't become bureaucrats, cooperate with fund managers, and settle into mansions. They did not live in mansions. Their crimes are very big. They did not bribe the BRSA president, or take bribes like the BRSA president, as alleged. There are such allegations against the president, you know. Do you know their crime? They reported the news. They reported the news. Özgür Özel said, look, Özgür Özel said at the time, the main opposition leader : "Ömer Çelik, AKP spokesperson Ömer Çelik , did you go on vacation in Bodrum with Osman Arıkan Nacar, who is alleged to be this fund swindler?" I asked. Ömer Çelik, look, the AKP spokesperson still hasn't answered. He still won't say, did you go to Bodrum or not? No, he still doesn't answer. But Mustafa Balcı, look, Ömer Çelik and Osman Arıkan Nacar are among the names said to have taken the most money in the fund swindle. He is still allegedly abroad and a fugitive. And at one point, it was claimed he took 20 billion TL. Then they say he took 81 million TL. They said he returned it, and so on. But he is a former bureaucrat, a former bureaucrat who headed departments in the most lucrative areas of the Ministry of Health. As soon as he retired, he founded a company with people who had also been bureaucrats in the most lucrative areas of the Ministry of Health. The company's value just soared. They became holding bosses. They became holding bosses while being all this. Then their shares in the fund also soared. That person, Osman Arıkan Nacar, and Ömer Çelik in Bodrum at the Limak 50th ...There are contractors called the " gang of five," Limak is one of them. At its 50th anniversary...Mustafa Balcı published a photo of him in Bodrum at the 50 th-anniversary event. In the same frame, Ömer Çelik and behind him, Osman Arıkan Nacar can be seen. This is a big crime. And they commented on this. Şaban Sevinç and I also commented. He shared some inside news. He commented on this photo . Their crimes are very big. Great criminals. The organization has been found. That dark organization turned out to be two people, the journalists. Carry on. Now they will face the judge with a 10- year prison sentence demand for Mustafa Balcı, and approximately 19 years—that is 18 years and 10 months—for Şaban Sevinç. The hearing is at 10 o'clock today at Çağlayan. Let's continue with the journalists. I saw Murat Arel. We went to the prison for a friend visit to see Murat Arel, and finally, finally , we were able to see our friend. After more than a month, we were able to talk through a glass partition on the phone. And Murat is doing very well. As Murat always says, "I'm fit as a fiddle." Murat is fit as a fiddle. Murat continues to report the news. Murat continues to research. Murat, I mean, he's looking at the insects, the centipedes in the garden, and things like that. Behind four walls. His crime is major. His crime is very major. Not doing journalism. Not doing journalism is a very major crime. I mean, nobody has committed such small crimes. I mean, he hasn't swindled 2.2 billion Turkish Liras like Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya, like "Fonzi" Fatma. That's a small crime. Or, you know, like Ta Çakmak, he didn't buy mansions or ultra-luxury vehicles as bribes while he was still a public official. Those are small crimes, you know. Or like Şahap Kavcıoğlu, those accusations of, "We gave him 200,000 dollars, we gave him 300,000 dollars," he didn't do those things. Like Melih Gökçek. Look, isn't Melih Gökçek's son Ahmet Gökçek? Daughter-in-law Hülya Gökçek. Murat Arel had exposed them. You know they had bought massive buildings in Germany for millions of Euros. He doesn't have such small crimes. You know, they go to the courthouse chewing gum, since they are small criminals, they go chewing gum. Nothing ever happens to them. Murat Arel's crime is major. Murat Arel is in prison because of an impression involving a person who confessed to money laundering abroad and is alleged to be a fraudster. We gave him the documents. Then the Sarıgüls threatened us. After that, we thought the documents had reached Murat . We were under that impression. Because they said so, Murat Arel is in prison. He is in prison only for this. There is no other accusation. That is the entire accusation. And he continues to lie in prison, in a cold cell, inside concrete. Oh, and by the way, the things that emerge don't matter at all. Dozens of messages proving his innocence , screenshots of messages, records, right? None of it matters. For example, months before Murat, a creature on YouTube said the same information had come to him. The Sarıgüls watch that footage too. I mean, because it's a news report constantly given by their own heads on a YouTube channel. But for some reason, the Sarıgüls don't get the news from there. It only counts when it's an impression from Murat. And so Murat Arel lies in prison. See? The "funders," their crimes are small. The crimes of journalists are very major . Every second stolen from our friend's life is a crime. By the way, Akın Gürlek, at the major press conference regarding the fund, the Minister of Justice, the Minister of Treasury and Finance, and the Vice President made a statement together. There, Akın Gürlek said that detention is an exceptional measure. Murat Arel is in prison. We will come to that subject. But now, this fund press release was important. Let's take a closer look at this fund announcement. Honestly, when I saw this fund announcement, I watched it just like the rest of the country, wondering what they would say. What kind of press conference would it be? What information would be obtained? When we waited for that, I saw the essence of it like this. We’re just one step away from apologizing to the fund scammers. I think we are going to apologize to the fund scammers. I mean, that seems to be where the process is heading. That probably is the summary of the press conference. I mean, it's the biggest robbery in world and Turkish history, mind you, the biggest, but there's nothing to blow out of proportion. I mean, they took 20 billion dollars in the first stage, of course. The damage to the country's economy will exceed 100 billion dollars. They will knowingly collaborate with public officials and the managers of all institutions to smuggle the country's money abroad while using "domestic and national" slogans. But if you look at this meeting, what I understood as a summary is truly that. There is nothing to blow out of proportion. I mean, what was announced is this: we are closing this fund curtain, closing the curtain on the fund. We have finished this business now. We will remove this from the agenda. I mean, we are no longer going to go to the end of it. No matter where it leads, none of that is happening. Do you know what else isn't in this press conference? The "angry Erdoğan" isn't there. That's over now. I mean, it went like this: Erdoğan is very angry, very angry. Erdoğan, Erdoğan is very mad. Erdoğan has a scalpel in his hand and he's going to cut. All measures will be taken and so on. No, those were just stalling tactics. It turns out Erdoğan isn't angry at all . On the contrary, the process is finished . The process is finished. Look, what was it? The process is very normal now. Cevdet Yılmaz said the state of emergency is over. He said we have reached the normal stage . And he, along with the Treasury and Finance Minister and Akın Gürlek, underscored that there is no situation to exaggerate and that the investigation is coming to an end. Now, when I listened to Mehmet Şimşek, I mean, when I listened to Treasury and Finance Minister Mehmet Şimşek, I was grateful. Thank God, I mean. Look, Kerim Rota made exactly that post . You suddenly see South Korea, you write . That is probably the summary of the event. We are grateful, I mean, wow, I mean, Nasdaq was terrible. I mean, South Korea is finished. South Korea is terrible. America and such, they are just crawling . And when you look at it, Indonesia and such are worse than us. Let us all be grateful for our state. That was the summary of Mehmet Şimşek's speech. I mean, we often listened to the comparison of this with other countries in the world, didn't we? But we were robbed. Those in South Korea weren't robbed by a massive organized gang with a political leg, a bureaucratic leg, and a leg of greedy manipulative capitalists. Is there such a gang in Indonesia too? Is there one in South Korea too? We never heard of such a scandal in America or anywhere. Someone robbed us, but I felt like Mehmet Şimşek thinks this robbery is also imaginary. He constantly used foreign examples to make his point. And of course, one conclusion we drew from this meeting is: forget the list, friends. There is no list. A list was supposed to be announced. 214 people, I mean, when this scam first happened, it has been over 2 months, you know. It has been 68 days. In these 68 days, they kept saying, " there is a list." 2,440 people stole 401 billion TL, right? 214 people stole 187 billion TL. We didn't say these things. We didn't make them up, I mean. The Minister of Justice gave these figures. Officials gave these figures. But it turns out they don't exist. Forget the list. They said this too. They are even attacking the opposition, asking why the opposition isn't releasing the list, friends. I mean, there are others too. In parliament, not at this mass press conference. We will get to that too. I mean, as I said, the organization, I mean, as that list shrank, as the list evaporated, the organization shrank too , little by little. It turns out there were 3-5 organizations. And these weren't some massive organizations, as far as we understand. I mean, 3-5 organizations committed such a huge robbery, like Tera, Pusula, and so on. So, it turns out it was a specific structure. And the main backbone has already been revealed. We already know it by now. They have been announced. Also, friends, arrest is an exceptional measure. Indeed, arrest is an exceptional measure . I mean, it turns out there is a right not to be stained. Mr. Cevdet said so. There is a presumption of innocence. I swear, if it weren't for the fund people in this country, we would have forgotten democracy. We have forgotten our legal rights, I mean. I mean, we derived this from that conclusion as well. I mean, it was a very strange press conference, really. But I want this a bit. Let's analyze the Minister of Interior's statements regarding this fund, uh, let's analyze them a bit. It deserves this; let's go over it position by position. Now, we already gave the answer to the question of why the press conference was held. The file on the world's biggest robbery is now being closed. The file is closing. I mean, it turns out that in this world's biggest robbery, like the shares of Özata Denizcilik, for instance, right ? It had become one of Turkey's most valuable companies, that shipyard in Tuzla. Or there was Gün Doğdu Gıda, right? There are two cows. There are also two employees. Actually, the two cows are a question mark. None. Everything, there is nothing at all. There is a closed factory. Man, you look, and they are more valuable than Arçelik, things like that . It turns out these were small organizational jobs. I mean, when everyone looked at the board in Turkey, everyone said "what is going on?" or when they saw Tera, everyone was describing it as a state project. One of the board members was a chief advisor to the President. The owner of Tera Holding was a member of the Borsa Istanbul financial market, the Crypto Chamber, and the Central Registry Agency. Look at the boss of Tera. The man became a dollar billionaire with his father. It was a made-up organization. Tera is one of those three or five organizations . They inflated it so much in the funds. Then, as if they did it among themselves . There must be such freedom in this country to manipulate shares now. They are so free; the Tera people have the presumption of innocence, the right not to be stained, every kind of right. They inflate those shares and then offer them to the public with the approval of the SPK. They attract the small investor, fleece them, and finish their business, right? It turns out these are just three or five organizations. They even get licenses, bank licenses, no less. They send the money all around the world. The Bahamas, Malta, England, Switzerland, I mean the whole world, Singapore and so on, they are moving the money all around the world. It's just three or five organizations, there is no major situation. We have already moved on to the normal process. Now, this is the main, main story. This is the main picture being painted. Now Cevdet Yılmaz spoke. He said they would close the curtains on the 450, you know, Erdoğan also said that results must be achieved as soon as possible. It must end as soon as possible. Erdoğan was very angry, very furious. He held a scalpel in his hand. He was going to follow this whole process. He was going to carry out a major purge. Then Erdoğan said, let no breaches open in the inner fortress. He said, let this process end as soon as possible. Ha, it finished. It's ending like this. It's closing. Look, Cevdet Yılmaz says there are more than 450,000 fund victims. He says 199 billion has been paid out. And he says we didn't use anything from the budget. We didn't use anything from the treasury . He says we didn't spend even a penny. He says the extraordinary period is over . He says we have moved to the normal situation now. He says there are one or two funds left . He says they have very little left in them. He says we generally gave the money back. He says we made interim payments to 98%of the investors, and so on. Brother, you look, you talk on social media, and so on. Nobody seems to have actually received their money. Such a rosy picture doesn't appear there at all. Now, let the fund victims explain this. Hey, we didn't get our money. That is actually the remaining money, you know, the money after the heist. That's not our actual principal, and so on, let them say those things. But it seems that uh, too many people will remain victimized. Because it is explained here. He said only assets are left, real estate. He didn't even give a time for when they would be sold. He said it would be paid in parts. I mean, for that reason, but look, this is what Cevdet Yılmaz said, and Cevdet Yılmaz is the Vice President, the head of the commission established regarding this fund. Head of the commission. He is also the head of the framework law regarding this fund business and that process. He is the head of the fund business, and so on . He is making statements every day about this fund incident. But he makes statements, yet his own personal secretary also turned out to be in the fund, if you remember. They entered the fund and lost 7 million . His own personal secretary. Now, there is also this. Regarding the fund, earlier he said our funds are very safe. Six months before the stocks exploded or whatever, he said don't keep money under the mattress, don't keep it in deposits , come to the funds. He says our funds are appreciating like this, and like that. He encouraged the people to invest in the funds. That wasn't enough, Pusula . There are photos of him giving an award to Serdar Turan, the owner of the Pusula holding. They have photos together like this. Look, Cevdet Yılmaz has come out now. He is managing this whole fund process. What would you say? You'd say he's in control of the process, right? My friends, he made a statement. I will ask Eren for that video. >> Every fund's, uh, thing is different. Honestly, in this process, I have also seen how many different kinds of finance , uh, funds there are. Mehmet Bey is more familiar with these matters, of course. Uh, there are very different funds. We just say "fund" and move on. There are money market funds, mutual funds, public ones, and closed ones. Anyway, there are many different funds. The process is managed according to the characteristics of each. >> I mean, what else can Cevdet Yılmaz say from what I understand of this business ? He says, "I don't understand these things, my brother." He says, "I don't know about these matters." He says, "I learned when this happened." He says, "I learned when this happened. " Apparently, I didn't understand anything on this subject. So, while recommending those funds and inviting people to them, he didn't understand anything either. He says, "I don't understand these things." What else can he say? What more can the man say? Work requires merit, work requires foresight. What else can he say? Now look, you might say, "Okay, he says he doesn't understand." Then he points to Mehmet Şimşek at the end of that speech. He says, "Mr. Mehmet knows these things ," and so on. Now, Mehmet Şimşek said he understands, but as I said, Mehmet Şimşek, I explained it a little while ago. He talked about South Korea, Indonesia, and Nasdaq in the USA. And everyone watched in amazement. As if the whole world's situation were bad or something. Our stock market and financial world lost 19.5%in value, but you look at others, developing countries lost 6%on average. 19.5%...I really struggle to understand it. Why do we deserve this? It touches our honor, Mr. Mehmet. It hurts our pride. What have we done to make you think that we, as a people, have such insufficient intelligence or such low mental capacity ? I mean, this is turning into an insult now. Don't do this to us. In South Korea, as I said, did they enter the financial world like that? Did they inflate the stocks? Did they inflate them by 1,000%, 10,000 %, 20,000%and then did their institutions say, "Open these to the public and fleece the small investor"? Now, on the other hand, one of the most important issues, as I mentioned a moment ago, was Akın Gürlek's statements . The investigation will be deepened as a result of new names emerging through confessions. But they say the main backbone exists. In fact, we talked about it yesterday, if you recall. Yeni Şafak newspaper also said 90%of the investigation was complete. They said there were 4 or 5 organizations. They said there wasn't just one single organization. Now he has also said this. Look, let me underline this first. Now the main backbone is completed. The main backbone is completed. How was the main backbone completed without the list of 214 people being announced? That's the first thing. We will go into more detail about the list in a bit. I mean, there is no action regarding the perpetrators yet. And there was the State Audit Board's report, remember? The preliminary report reached Erdoğan's desk. Where is that report? Was that main backbone completed without even considering that report? Or is the main backbone just the CMB, the judiciary—the state itself—meaning those actors in the public sector, the bureaucracy, that bureaucratic tutelage , that structure we call the bureaucratic oligarchy? Was the main backbone that? Are Emre Tezmen, Serdar Turhan, the 28-year-old AKP member Muhammed Yarız, and Erdin Özel the main backbone then? Is that how we should perceive it? Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya is just an organization member. In a place where an AKP Deputy Chair is an organization member, how was the main backbone completed without us seeing the founder of the organization, the leader, the charts, the scheme, or the bureaucrats who helped the organization? How was the main backbone completed in an organizational investigation without putting the organizational charts forward, without showing the scheme, and without even giving the organization a name? Because they wanted it to be completed now. And look, the writing of the indictment has begun, as Gürlek explained. In 68 days, look, the world's biggest robbery, the indictment starts in 68 days. The world's biggest robbery, and the indictment starts in 68 days. The writing of it is starting. I swear, I know journalists. I remember Furkan Karabay. He spent a year in prison. An indictment wasn't written for a year because of two tweets. Now, put the bribery networks on the screen. So, have these all been resolved ? Was the main backbone just this? We, we, I mean we, what we heard back then and what we did, which wasn't even the tip of the iceberg, was apparently enough. These are. Just what we already know. Yeah, now, I mean these, but I remember something. For instance, there was also this. Akın Gürlek came out and said there is a media leg to this as well. He mentioned a bureaucracy leg, a network that has infiltrated the state, and so on. That’s how he described it. At the same time, he said 214 people stole 187 billion TL. I mean, without these, I don't understand how the main backbone is completed. What happened to the media leg, for example? I mean, has the media leg of this main backbone been uncovered? We haven't seen it, that is. Is there an investigation into this, or are things like the presumption of innocence and the right not to be stigmatized hidden? Are they not visible ? We can't figure it out. Look, at the same time, as I said, if it weren't for the funded ones, I mean, democratic rights like the right not to be stigmatized, the presumption of innocence, and detention being an exceptional measure in the country. We wouldn't even know about these. Thank God for the funded ones, honestly . Look, now a journalist asked as well. They asked a question about the release of "Fonzi" Fatma, and look at how Gültekin responded. >> To the Minister of Justice, uh, now, uh , there are criticisms from the opposition that the release of Fatma Betül, who is identified with this investigation, after 19 days, or at least her getting out, hurts the public conscience. >> A person paying off their debt, that is , paying their debt into the recovery account, and subsequently being released by a court decision does not mean this person is no longer legally responsible . Of course, this criminal investigation, as I just told you again, of course, a criminal investigation can be conducted . >> I mean, a criminal investigation can be conducted, yes, but look now, I mean, he says she paid the money, well, a part of it. I mean, that is a separate situation, normally according to the CMB law, she is supposed to pay double. Uh, so she robbed the bank, she robbed the public, she robbed the entire public . Then she returned the money. She stayed in prison for 19 days, then returned home. That's it. Uh, but the Minister of Justice says, " Well, that measure continues," meaning she is still being tried. Well, of course, she is being tried, did anyone say she was acquitted? There is no such thought. Look, he says something, but I mean, Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya was released with a report claiming her daughter's psychology was negatively affected. Murat Çalık, the Mayor of Beylikdüzü, look, his bones were broken three times during surgery. He has a severe cancer condition, you know. In prisons, there are people with very severe illnesses who cannot even take care of their own needs. But this release of "Fonzi" Fatma, look , even in this very incident, with the press statement saying, "We are closing the curtain now," I say it's very obvious she was someone's person. I mean, it is now being announced that we are closing this, we aren't going anywhere. I mean, the political leg of this isn't emerging. That is actually the summary of the press statement too. Forget the political leg. You won't see the political leg. Now, the list was asked about here, of course. A response was given to a question primarily about the list. Look , the response was given by Cevdet Yılmaz. He said, "I can express what I understand from the list." We are all waiting, aren't we? The whole country is waiting for the list. But they haven't understood the list. So, Mr. Cevdet says he doesn't understand the fund either. He also says he doesn't understand the list. But he claims he does. First, there are the individuals and institutions reported by the CMB, the Capital Markets Board. The CMB files criminal complaints. This process is ongoing. It will be completed by the end of this month. Those who are curious can check the CMB's website. Now, the CMB makes announcements and so on. But friends, there is a situation like this. Look, the CMB did not file a criminal complaint against Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya, despite what they say. If it hadn't been disclosed, if the IYI Party hadn't revealed it, we still wouldn't know about Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya. We wouldn't have known that she swindled 2.2 billion TL from the public. They would have said that politicians are not involved in this. Now Cevdet Yılmaz says, "Look at the CMB , the list is there." Even Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya isn't there. So that CMB list, the criminal complaints they filed, don't mean much then. It means politicians cannot be there. Politicians don't appear there. Uh, but Cevdet Yılmaz also says this. He says there is something he understands regarding a second list. The list under the judicial process. He says this is also being investigated . It is the independent judiciary that will decide this. The "funders." If it weren't for the funders, we wouldn't know there is an independent judiciary in Turkey. When the indictments are issued and these names are revealed, the public will hear them. Well, that is our point anyway. Let the list be released so these people can be tried. Let them not be shielded from the judiciary. Let the political side of this emerge. We are waiting for that, but they say, " Look at the CMB list." But it's not there. "Look at the indictment." Will it be there? Exactly. Look, isn't the politicization and instrumentalization of the judiciary a huge problem? That's why, for this reason, we cannot do something. We cannot learn the truth. We cannot learn the facts. You always approach it with suspicion. Look, all of this is being discussed. Then, after talking about those list stories and such, Cevdet Yılmaz says, " They are trying to gain political rent from this." He says, "They are playing politics over this.""They are abusing this," he says. He also says this. There are all sorts of things in the municipalities. He says those who don't react to those are reacting to this. Well, friends, I mean, let's just imagine for a moment that the municipal cases aren't entirely based on secret witness testimonies. Let's say those cases aren't happening just because Ekrem İmamoğlu is a presidential candidate. Let's say they weren't done to destroy his candidacy. And let's say they aren't being done to seize control of the municipalities. Let's say they aren't political cases. Let's even say this didn't happen either . Let's all forget these things together . Like, three council members are detained . Four of them are transferred. One is reinstated because he will vote for the AKP. The municipality is like islands; there are two AKP members, ten CHP members. The municipality shifts to the AKP. Or like Üsküdar. I mean, let's just say none of these things happened. Assume these operations are not political. Assume, to the very end, that this indictment isn't what it is; forget about it starting with phrases like " Erdoğan the octopus." Let's even pretend that Ekrem İmamoğlu wanting to be president isn't presented as a crime in the indictment. And let's say money was even found as evidence. Let's say it was found. You know how money was scattered around in the " fountain" case, right? Money everywhere . We see it in the records. There is no money like that at the IMM. But let's assume that happened too. Wouldn't they say, "Enough already"? Wouldn't they say this when Mr. Cevdet says such things? Well then, let there be dawn operations here too. Right? Let homes be raided. Let images of the ladies and women opening the doors be filmed and served to the media. Let there be disclosures regarding people's private lives. Let slanderous headlines be written. Slander, headline after headline like that. Then let them turn out to be lies . Let people be smeared. Is this what we are going to compare? I mean, these people have serious health issues; Murat Çalık, for instance, applied for release. I mean, is this what we are going to compare? Let people who are seriously ill be kept inside. Let strip searches be conducted in prison. Let people against whom there is only a secret witness statement—or not even that—be kept in prison for over 600 days . Is this the comparison? Is this how we should do it? There is no seizure of digital materials here, no operation, no detention footage . You know how people were lined up one by one at the IMM; there is no such image here. So, it means this case is different. In this case, in this process, the AKP is found under every rock, and yet we hear talk about the presumption of innocence, the right not to be stigmatized, and being overly sensitive about not releasing lists because "we might be embarrassed." Look, that is not enough either, friends . Look, I am going to ask Eren for another clip now. Look at the speech in Parliament. The AKP's deputy group chairman is speaking. Muhammet Emin Akbaşoğlu. >> So you are saying, "Let the lists be released." Didn't you, as the opposition, say this ? "You release them by Monday." "Otherwise we will release them," you said. How many Mondays have passed. You haven't released them; release them . Is there anyone holding your hand? Why aren't you releasing the list? >> So now the opposition is guilty for not releasing the list, friends, isn't that nice? I mean, at this point, uh, I don't know what to call it; there are no words to describe it. If there isn't an operation against the opposition soon for not releasing the list, well, you might be surprised—they might just do it. "The opposition isn't releasing the list, launch an operation, arrest them all, lift their immunities, throw them in, let there be a dawn operation," is that it? Can they just come to the courthouse by invitation? How can that be? These are the opposition. A dual legal system. Now, not only is he saying these things , but he then took it from Mahmut and went out and said, "Sir, Mr. Muhammet was made a civil servant through an exceptional quota." And he says, "You are a lawyer, I am a lawyer, we can do this job." He says, " The house I live in is clear." He says, "You live in a villa in Çekmeköy that was built on that military land, worth who knows how many millions , not billions, of liras." He says, "Now you are saying these things, too." Mahmut has made such a comparison as well. Now, actually, look, there was something else very interesting in this press conference: the election date. The election date was one of the points that left its mark on the agenda. Since they said nothing about the funds , statements regarding the election date became very significant. Cevdet Yılmaz said that there would be no early elections. He stated that there would be no such thing as an early election. He even said that the election would be in 2028. Look, he explained this quite clearly here, and he even went further. He added that even if it's moved up by a week or two, or maybe a month, he called that an early election too. Now, there is a rule in the Constitution , right? Friends, is the Constitution trampled upon like this? There is a rule in the Constitution. It is determined how many times the President can be a candidate. Isn't it? What is the point of deceiving the Constitution or trampling on it? If you move the election up by two months, Erdoğan already said it. He said we need Erdoğan's leadership. The region is a ring of fire, and so on. He said Erdoğan's leadership is important, and so on. Then he said that is why the 2028 election would be moved up. Mehmet Şimşek said the same thing. We talked about it in the economic program. He said the election is in 2028. He also said there is no election before that. And they explain this as if it's a normal thing. We are trampling on the Constitution. We are deceiving the Constitution. Because normally he shouldn't be able to run again, but we put it in the Constitution that if the parliament makes such a decision, he can run again . But only if it's an early election, and only for two months. You are saying this. Look, you are saying this and claiming that we need Erdoğan's leadership. Erdoğan isn't angry at all. Look, you are saying we need such strong leadership from Erdoğan. They robbed the country. They ruined the country's economy. They were grabbing and taking away the country's treasury, coffers, and finances. They committed the biggest robbery in the world's history. And according to your words, your own statements, Erdoğan knew nothing about it. What kind of leadership is that? And in this incident, in this robbery, those appointed with Erdoğan's signature are in the key positions of that organization. So, saying there is a need for strong leadership at this press conference sounds a bit absurd. But apparently, there is no election. The election date is 2028. Look, they also say the main backbone has been completed. The curtain on the funds is closing. Yerlikaya still hasn't spoken. Look, Emre Tepe said, "He wanted to see me at the head of the economy." He told me, "My son, you are domestic and national, you will come to lead the economy," he said. Erdin Özel gave the same statement; it's like a pair, something like that. He even said that Eriş Arıcan nominated me for the Central Registry Agency. They explained everything. He even mentioned Ereten Aydın, the former AKP member and architect of the "Century of Turkey" slogan. He even said in his statement, "We were talking with Ereten Aydın, and Ereten Aydın said that Eriş Arıcan has a secret safe." The Turkey Wealth Fund, or rather the deputy chairman of the Wealth Fund after Erdoğan, Taha Çakmak, also explained that he told Eriş Arıcan, "We gave the shares, the public's money, their deposits, from a public institution to ..." "Uh, to TERA. I tried to get it back, then we gave it to Pusula, we gave it to TERA. I tried to retrieve it, but you can't, it's in trouble here, and those at Takasbank are in trouble too," he said. He is aware of everything. Eriş Arıcan is not speaking. He isn't giving any account. We, the poor public, just stand here watching. The main backbone is set, the indictment is ready, the organization is dismantled , we paid the money, the case is closing , it's over. Friends, Eriş Arıcan hasn't made a statement yet; how can the curtain be closing? The main actors haven't spoken yet. How can the curtain close? Look, even Hidayet Türkoğlu isn't speaking; look, he's a presidential advisor. The president of the Turkish Basketball Federation went with Ali Emre Ballı and with the people involved in the fund, look, he paid a visit to Gürlek. Look, this Ali Emre Ballı, who is sitting right here, was found dead in his car. He was also in the basketball federation . He was found dead in his car. He is one of the names where everything intersects. He is partners with Mustafa Yazıcı, the son of Hayati Yazıcı. And what happened? Hidayet Türkoğlu isn't speaking. He didn't speak in that instance either. He had visited Galip Öztürk in Batumi, by going to Georgia. A wanted criminal. Guilty of murder. Living in Batumi. They visited him too. It's a "who is where" pose. He isn't speaking. What? I'm keeping quiet. The level of comfort they have is truly only found in the palace; it doesn't exist anywhere else. They don't speak, and they don't give an account. Well, permission has finally been granted for Şahap Kavcıoğlu. Look, Şahap Kavcıoğlu will speak, his statement can finally be taken. What allegations are there about him, right? What kind of schemes he's been involved in; I won't repeat them, you can open and watch the old episodes if you want. All sorts of things. 200,000 dollars, 300,000 dollars, gold bars. He was a partner in Pusula, a partner in Katılım Evim, promises, and so on. All sorts of things. Cars, offices arranged for his son, and so on. What kind of allegations are there about him ? Meetings in VIP rooms. Ali Emre Ballı, Taha Çakmak. Ali, Ali Emre, and all the other characters in that sector. It is very strange. The name will finally give a statement. They haven't destroyed the evidence, have they? Like Ponzi Fatma. Their houses aren't being raided, their digital materials aren't being seized. They are being waited for, and after months, they go and give statements as a favor. Meanwhile, the organization's main backbone emerged. Of course, the main backbone emerges. Their digital materials haven't even been examined yet . The messages haven't even been looked at. If an investigation is conducted this way—without an organizational chart, without looking at digital materials— the investigative backbone is formed. No detentions, no house searches. Let's see what Şahap Kavcıoğlu will say once his statement is taken. But the main backbone is already finished. So that means his statement won't be very effective. If the main backbone is moving this fast. We won't be able to learn what schemes the bureaucrats were involved in. Now, Ahmet Şık also made a post. There is a final list announced by the CMB. One announced in a criminal complaint bulletin. Now, as you know, TIP MP Ahmet Şık has been raising an allegation for a long time. When Özgür Özel previously accused Akin Gürlek of issues regarding title deeds when he was Deputy Minister of Justice, he alleged that a person named Hayrettin Koç was Akin Gürlek's bagman and proxy. Akin Gürlek does not respond to any parliamentary questions. He has not responded to any parliamentary question from the assembly to this day, you know. Now, in the post Ahmet Şık made, he said this in the news. Hayrettin Koç's sons, Efe Koç and Umut Koç, are even around 18 years old or so . He says they have a company called Savur GYO. He said this company finally appeared in the CMB bulletin. Ahmet Şık asked questions again in his Twitter post. For instance, he asked if the assets, bank accounts, and capital market transactions of Hayrettin Koç and his family had been comprehensively examined . Were the allegations that there were billions of liras in Efe Koç and Umut Koç's accounts investigated? What is the source of these funds? Have the senders, recipients, and final destinations of the money transfers, allegedly made from accounts linked to the Koç family, been identified? What are their roles in the shares related to Terra Investment and Terra Portfolio? Have their connections to the Koç family and possible transaction record relationships been investigated? Why are the suspicious transactions carried out in other shares and investment funds, besides Savur GYO, not being disclosed to the public in all their aspects? He says that Özgür Özel described Hayrettin Koç as a bagman. He asks why no clear, concrete, and documented answer is being provided regarding the allegations of protection and favoritism raised about his relationship with Akin Gürlek. Who is protecting whom? Those are the kinds of questions Ahmet Şık is asking regarding the fund. Now, also, look, this gang story is very interesting. Barış Terkoğlu had reported on it before. This shooting, this threatening, the Daltons threatening some of the names in this fund scandal; remember, Mustafa Sandal's wife, Melis Sandal, had a father involved too. And his father's relatives 'house was shot at, and allegedly, it's a complete gang job; they say they took this job from Telegram. The family is being threatened from abroad. When you look at the family's house, it’s not that flashy; you know, they had earned about 4 billion dollars—sorry, 4 billion liras—from this business, they had only put in 1 billion TL or something, it's a strange thing. It's a modest house, but they are shooting at it. They are saying things like, "You will give us money." There is such a situation. Now, also, the Constitutional Court rejected Imamoglu's application. It rejected his application regarding his detention, claiming he was tried unfairly and that his right to vote and be elected was violated. It said no, there is no violation. Now, because he is not like "Fonzi Fatma," Fonzi Fatma gets out immediately, but Ekrem Imamoglu's incarceration is considered constitutional. Now, there is also an announcement, of course. Look, this is really important: the Governor of Kilis. Now, an appointment, you know, a decree on governors has been announced. The Muğla governor, whom we exposed, had been involved in the fund scandal. His... In a sense, he was written off and has now been recalled to the center. But the appointments of some governors also drew excessive attention as well. Now, as I mentioned, one of them, appointed as the Governor of Kilis, Yusuf Alperen Ayar, is the former AKP Ankara Provincial Youth Branch President . Ramazan Bal, who once served on the protection team for AKP President Erdoğan, was also appointed as the Governor of Karabük. Now, DEVA Party MP Gülistan Kılıç Koçyiğit made a speech regarding this. No. Does he come from a background in civil administration? No. Does he have any government experience? No. He was put into an exceptional cadre, and from there, he just hopped over to become the governor of Kilis. Well, is it just him ? Look, Ramazan Bal, who was in Mr. Erdoğan's Protection Detail. They made him the governor of Karabük, too. What a wonderful country. Why do we even study ? Why do the children of this nation study? Why do they graduate from political science schools? Just to become bodyguards for someone. >> I mean, being a bodyguard or in the AKP Youth Branch—he claims he hasn't even been a district governor for one day. This is truly moving to a whole new level in a party-state. Merit. Look, there's merit. Merit is such a valuable word, isn't it? Merit. He explained how he learned from his cell that Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya had been released. And he has an article on Onlar TV. He also added a news report to it. Murat Arel continues to do journalism from prison. And he produced a very important and good report. You can watch Murat Arel's report on Onlar TV and see how he learned about Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya's freedom from his cell. But I have one more request. Your letters to Murat Arel. Murat Arel cherishes your letters. He is in a cold cell, but receiving these letters is very precious and important to him. Murat Arel, Kocaeli No. 2 F-Type Prison , C Block-12/103, Prison FTT Branch, Kandıra, Kocaeli. Murat Arel is waiting for your letters. Goodbye.

items.transkript: Justice. Justice according to whom? Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya has been released . I just smiled. This saying came to my mind. Laws are like a spider's web. The weak and small get caught, while the strong and rich tear through it and pass. After all, in this country, laws only exist for us. Let me list them one by one. In the Can Holding investigation, when asked how and why institutions alleged to have been purchased with funds of unknown origin were acquired, a holding executive replied, "A senior state official told us to." The prosecutor did not ask who this senior state official was. As far as I know, there is no one in custody as part of the investigation either. Yet, we were talking about hundreds of billions of Turkish liras. What happened? Nobody knows. Assets were frozen for Hayati Yazıcı's son's companies. Hours later, the freeze was lifted. The company partner was found dead in his car. A Yeni Şafak columnist claimed that a remark was made saying, "He who will arrest my son has not been born yet." It was alleged that these words were spoken by Hayati Yazıcı. The claim was denied. We do not know if those words were truly spoken or not. However, despite being questioned twice, he was indeed not arrested. I wrote two books about Melih Gökçek and his family. I penned dozens of articles. Finally, I brought his son's assets in Germany to the public agenda with documents and videos. Is writing articles and books a proof of guilt? It is not. But they all consisted of irregularities based on material facts and documents. I cannot even imagine what would have happened to any opposition mayor if they had committed these irregularities. When I wrote about the incident in Germany, the prosecutor's office finally launched an investigation. Melih Gökçek came to the prosecutor's office chewing gum. His son and daughter-in-law were summoned for testimony. They were released with a travel ban. Months passed, the investigation did not progress. It is clear it will not progress. Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya studied abroad with a scholarship she received from the Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality. She benefited from the blessings of power with her family. She served as a minister. She invested 160 million Turkish liras into the stock market in one go. 99%of this country could not earn 160 million liras even if they worked their entire lives, let alone billions. But Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya earned 2.2 billion Turkish liras in a single move. She was invited to the prosecutor's office. The first time, she entered through the protocol gate. After receiving backlash, she had to use the citizen entrance. She was arrested. 18 days passed and she was released. Health issues were cited as the reason. According to another claim, the psychological state of her child was influential. Do not get me wrong. I am not asking why she was released. My question is different. Why this double standard? If health issues are the reason, are Tayfun Kahraman and Murat Çalık sicker than her? If it is about the psychological state of her child, what is the difference for Vera and Ada? If the presumption of innocence applies to everyone, why are we in prison? They could not arrest the Gökçeks, nor Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya, nor Hayati Yazıcı's son. Law is not a mechanism to be bent and twisted according to the person. The same law, the same measure, and the same justice must be applied to everyone. Withholding humanitarian sensitivity shown to one from another, or denying legal opportunities granted to one to another, destroys the sense of justice. It is now clearly visible that the rich cannot be arrested in Turkey. I am saying this clearly. Arrest is not a method of preemptive punishment. Depriving a person of their freedom should be the exception. Moreover, the grounds for this exception must be clear and verifiable for everyone. The reputation of the judiciary is not measured by how harshly it treats people , but by its ability to remain equidistant to all. Arrests have turned into an institutionalized form of anger. What is even more painful is that trust in justice has also become a matter of privilege among people. How someone enters the gate, how long they stay detained, whose health condition is considered, and whose family's pain is acknowledged are now all evaluated by different standards. Yet, justice is not a privilege that the wealthy demand for themselves. It should be the final port where the poor can also seek refuge. I recognize this evil; I see it. Do you even know? I am touching this evil. This evil has eyes, but it does not see . It has ears, but it does not hear. It has a heart, but it does not feel. When it comes to us, that is when the law falls silent and justice goes blind . And all that remains is that heavy question that pierces the soul. Is justice really for everyone in this country? Anyway, let's get back to our business. Fire department and municipal police appointments. You scrimp and save, struggling through a thousand difficulties just so your child can get an education. Our children work day and night under stress to get into university. They get into university. Then another struggle begins. They graduate after struggling with housing problems, inadequate and poor food, and financial hardship. Then they study hard again to get a foot in the door of the state. They take exams. Even if they pass the exams, they are eliminated in the interviews. They spend their most productive and dynamic years this way. And then there are the politically privileged, favored, lucky people. Who am I talking about? One of the services municipalities provide is the fire department, and the other is the municipal police. Among the fire department's duties, according to the legislation, are tasks that contribute to public safety, such as intervening in and extinguishing fires and conducting all kinds of search and rescue operations. For this reason, it has administrative law enforcement duties and authority. The Constitutional Court, in its decision number 56 dated 2019, states that firefighting duties must be carried out by public officials. It is not possible for these duties to be performed by individuals who are not public officials, nor is it possible to make regulations to that effect. "It says. Isn't it very clear? I am reading the Court of Accounts reports. There are incredible findings on this matter. No one is taking the Constitutional Court's decision into account. In the Kayseri Metropolitan Municipality Court of Accounts report, it was determined that in 2025, a total of 111 people, consisting of 78 drivers and 33 firefighters among KAYMEK A.Ş. employees , were employed as firefighting personnel. Is it only this municipality? For instance, in the Gaziantep Metropolitan Municipality, 243 people were made firefighting personnel in this way. In the Sakarya Metropolitan Municipality , 196 people hired through service procurement and holding worker status were made firefighting personnel. In the Konya Metropolitan Municipality, 469 people were made firefighting personnel in this way. In the Kocaeli Metropolitan Municipality , 203 people hired with worker status were made firefighting personnel. In the Manisa Metropolitan Municipality , 468 people were made firefighting personnel in this way. In the Denizli Metropolitan Municipality, 392 people were made firefighting personnel in this way. Bitlis, Muşki, Çorum, Bolu, Çankırı, Bitlis, Tatvan, Kastamonu, Samsun Metropolitan, Kahramanmaraş Metropolitan , Sivas, Afyonkarahisar, Düzce, Giresun Görele, Kastamonu Araç, Kastamonu Devrekani. In some reports, auditors did not even bother to provide figures. The total number I could identify as being made fire department personnel is 2206. What about the municipal police? While municipal police services, which are continuous in nature, should be carried out by officers meeting the qualifications set out in the municipal police regulations, personnel procured through subsidiaries were assigned as municipal police officers. The Court of Accounts auditor stated in their report that temporary assignments can only be made for office services. Yet, is there anyone in this country who cares about the law, statutes, or the constitution? The auditor inspecting Kocaeli Metropolitan Municipality identified 915 people who were hired through service procurement and later made municipal police officers at the municipality. Gaziantep 107, Konya 126, Bolu 38, Manisa 367, Sakarya 28, Kastamonu 20, Istanbul Esenler 70, Izmir Seferihisar 9 . 1680 people in total. Look, dear readers. I have no issue with the people getting jobs and trying to earn a living. However, regardless of who it is done to , this injustice and lawlessness is wrong. This is the fire department, my friend. They save lives in forest, house, and workplace fires. These individuals fight superhumanly during earthquakes. They are surely going through training, but what about those who earned this right through exams? This is wrong.

items.transkript: Hello. Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya was released under house arrest. It was decided she could not remain in prison due to health reasons. She was sent to the home where she had stayed for 18 days, as a favor and out of consideration. For the opposition, it’s Silivri; for Ms. Fatma, it’s her own home. Her arrest, even if only for show, was actually quite surprising, but her release so quickly after just 18 days was, of course, no surprise to anyone. Today, we will discuss this cautionary tale with details not talked about anywhere else. We will discuss it in the form of a mini-documentary, especially to entrust it to the digital archives of our youth . Be patient. Whenever there is a matter like this that needs to be covered up, what happens simultaneously? An incredibly interesting coincidence occurs. A drug operation happens just like that . It happened the same way this time too. While the "Ponzi" Ms. Fatma was being sent home, at those exact same minutes, people including Özcan Deniz, Deniz Çakır, Burcu Özberk, I don't know, Survivor host Murat Ceylan, and the son of New Party MP Namık Tan were taken into custody over drugs. The cameras turned to the celebrities all of a sudden, right? Actually, if you look at it, even if they had detained Tom Cruise instead of Özcan Deniz, it’s impossible to forget the "Ponzi" Ms. Fatma, but they did take them. We will talk about this today. But before all of that, look, before all of that. I want to talk about the famous lion. It was a famous culprit, but then it became an unknown perpetrator. The lion news turned out to be a hoax. You must have followed it in Sarıyer. They said there was a lion on the security camera. Man, Istanbul went on alert. The whole of Turkey focused on it . Social media was on fire. There were even witnesses who said, " Yes, we saw it." Some talked about climbing a pole out of fear. Some described it running fast toward that wooded area and so on. Drones were flown. More than 100 drones were flown, man. They said thermal cameras had located it , for heaven's sake. Didn't they say that? They said, "We have detected it." Experts watching the footage even said the lion was female. They called it a lioness. National park teams, AFAD teams, and such started search operations. Fully equipped commando units were deployed to the field. The Belgrade Forest was put under blockade. Entry and exit were banned and so on. The Istanbul Governorate set up a coordination center to catch the lion. I mean, the female headman of Uskumruköy , you'd think she was a White House spokesperson, giving such serious statements and everything. On television, they were explaining which regions the lion might have escaped to using villa sticks. They put up maps and everything in the villas. From women's programs to football programs, man, everyone was talking about the lion. The result? The lion news was a hoax. What did the Istanbul Governorate say? They said no concrete evidence of a lion was found in the region. It was concluded that what was thought to be a lion on the security camera was actually a cat. Man, a cat. The cat—the lion turned out to be a cat , man. The famous culprit lion turned out to be a cat. Now, we are laughing at this comedy, of course, but it is actually a cautionary tale, look. It is a cautionary situation for Turkey . It is cautionary in terms of showing the speed at which fake news and incorrect information spread in society. It spread through social media to the very capillaries of Turkey. I mean, from Hakkari to Artvin, from Trabzon, Antalya, Isparta, this whole of Turkey, everyone was talking about the lion. Because no real news can spread as fast as fake news. Yes. Look, the concept we call information is actually four-dimensional. Let's make a quick analysis; it is four-dimensional. As a communications professional, I would like to try and explain this subject, especially for our young people . Because, unfortunately, Turkey is a country where fake news is experienced in its most terrifying dimensions. Yes. Look, the world's most prestigious scientific institution, Oxford University, conducted a worldwide fake news study. It turns out that we have the most unethical media and the most unethical social media in the world. Yes. They scanned the media of 37 countries, from Mexico to Malaysia, Brazil to England, Japan to Denmark, and Argentina to Bulgaria. They especially scanned their social media. It turns out our media is the most disgusting in the world, knowingly feeding its own nation fake news, spreading fabricated false stories, intentionally conveying wrong information, and slandering with fake documents. Oxford University says so. Do you know they even censored this news in Turkey? Yes. Therefore, on the occasion of this lion news that turned out to be a balloon, I want to present this topic to the attention of our youth. The concept we call information has four dimensions. Information, disinformation, mal-information, and mis-information. It has four dimensions. Information is often used in the media as a synonym for knowledge, but it is not actually knowledge. Information consists of data particles that emerge from the collection and interpretation of data on a specific subject. Yes. Knowledge, on the other hand, is the more holistic form of this information— these pieces of data—once they are analyzed and interpreted by the human brain. Therefore, information is not knowledge . If the information is wrong, the knowledge cannot be true. If the information is a lie, can the knowledge based on that information be true? If it is a lie, look, if the information is a lie, it is actually disinformation . Meaning the knowledge is false. Those who spread this information have malicious intent. They have intentionally produced and spread this lie to mislead the individual and the public, to manipulate , and to cause harm. It is a perception management strategy. The concept of disinformation actually has Russian origins, yes. It was first established within the Soviet Union's Secret Service in history, look. In 1920 , if I'm not mistaken. It was actually the name of the propaganda and deception unit established within the Soviet Union's Secret Service. Russian. I don't know if I'm saying it right, in Russian. Later, after World War II, during the Cold War era, the disinformation phenomenon passed to Westerners. The root of the word disinformation was the name of the propaganda and deception unit established within the Soviet Union's Secret Service. It comes from there anyway. The knowledge is false. Those who spread this knowledge have malicious intent. It means information spread to mislead and manipulate the public. It means false information. The third dimension of disinformation is mal-information. Mal-information. Here, in this mal-information, the information is actually true, but the person spreading it has malicious intent , yes. In disinformation, the information is a lie, and the person spreading it spreads the lie. But in mal-information, the information is actually true. The person spreading it has malicious intent. They serve the information by intentionally bending and twisting it, taking it out of context. It is used for character assassination. For example, a piece of a politician's phone conversation or an email is published. This information is true, but the intention is different. The intention is actually to destroy that targeted person . Or, a compromising image of a politician is obtained through illegal means. The image is actually true, but when they spread it, they do it for character assassination. The name for this is mal-information. The fourth dimension of information. is mis-information. This is the broadest version, look, misinformation. It is the sharing of false, incorrect, or misleading information without malicious intent, without the aim of harming anyone, believing it to be true . Look, the lion news in this Sarıyer area is typical misinformation. Yes. And the trap we fall into most often as a society is this, misinformation. No real news can spread as fast as untrue news. Believing a lie without realizing it is far, far easier than learning the truth . A scientific study was conducted on this in the US, look, by MIT. MIT is also one of the world's most prestigious universities. According to the study conducted at MIT , the spread rate of false information is six times faster than that of accurate information. The spread rate of disinformation and misinformation is six times faster than accurate news. One must be very careful. One must not fall into this trap. Because that is unfortunately the nature of human psychology. The human brain reacts much faster to surprising, extraordinary, or newly heard information rather than expected truths. While accurate news often evokes painful or sad emotions in people, fake news creates feelings of astonishment, fear, and anger. These emotions like astonishment, fear, and anger, which create high arousal, slow down people's logical filters and accelerate the urge to share immediately . Moreover, there is another dimension. People want to be the first to relay information heard for the first time. We want to get ahead of each other on this matter. Actually, did you know that journalists have this too? One wants to stand out in their own social circle regarding this. "Let me be the first to announce it," one wants to be the one to break it and thinks that by being the first, they are more valuable in their own social circle. They think they gain value. Thus, they spread it without confirming whether it is true. They care about how many clicks it gets , not whether it is true. What happens when it's like this? I just explained it. The world's most prestigious scientific institution, Oxford University, is conducting research on fake news on social media worldwide. Unfortunately, Turkey turns out to be the most unethical social media environment in the world. We laugh at the cat that turned out to be a lion, but it actually has such painful and tragic consequences. Our media is already more than lying enough. It's a small change for disinformation. And when citizens become voluntary accomplices to lying and misinformation on social media, Turkey becomes the most unethical social media environment in the world. It is truly very difficult to reach real information in Turkey. The patient that turned out to be a cat in Sarıyer has such a cautionary outcome that no one talks about. Coming to this drug operation that turned into a "to be continued" serial. You know, whenever there is an issue that needs to be urgently covered up like Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya, what happens simultaneously? An extremely interesting coincidence occurs. Pop, a drug operation happens. Like a " to be continued" series. It happened like that this time too. While "Funding" Fatma Lady was being sent home, at the same minutes, among them Özcan Deniz, Deniz Çakır, and Burcu Özberk... Murat Ceylan from Survivor, almost everyone was taken in the drug bust; even the son of New Party Deputy Namık Tan was detained. The cameras suddenly turned to these celebrities, right? Now, I actually explained this topic before, back when Dilan Polat, who wore dollar bills as hair curlers, was arrested. I had explained with the bicycle example how, while we should be focusing on real problems, people like Dilan Polat are suddenly made the number one item on the agenda, drawing all attention there as if they were fighting major criminals, creating such a hype and atmosphere. Now look, they picked up Özcan Deniz, Deniz Çakır, and such; it is the same bicycle issue again. Sometimes we explain things too early. It cannot be fully grasped. With the hope that it might be understood this time, let me explain it again. Our attentive viewers know. A Mexican was crossing into the US by bicycle. Crossing from the Mexican border or something. He was crossing the border gate on a bike, and he had a huge bag on his saddle. The border police were suspicious, of course. "Open that bag, let's see," they said. The Mexican opened it. It turned out to be sand, I mean, sand. There was just plain sand in the bag. He passed through. The next day, the same Mexican came pedaling along, whistling, to the same border gate. He was going to enter with his bicycle. There was a huge bag on his saddle again . The border police were suspicious again , of course. "Open that bag, let's see, " they said. He opened it, man, sand again. The next day, the same Mexican came pedaling to the border gate again. There was a bag on his saddle once more . This time, narcotics police met him along with the customs police. Because something was up, they said, " Open that bag." He opened it. It was futile, man. All that came out was sand again. The narcotics guys were going crazy. Man, 3 days, 5 days, 2 weeks, 1 month, always the same scene. The Mexican comes along on his bike, riding leisurely. Man, they search with thermal cameras. They take samples from the sand and analyze them. They make narcotics dogs sniff it and all. They follow his movements with satellite photos and such . It's a story, my brother. Nothing but plain sand keeps coming out of the bag. Always the same. Anyway, as time went by, years passed. The border policeman, who was going crazy and bursting with curiosity at that border, went into a bar to drink a cold beer. Look at the coincidence, man . He ran into the Mexican who used to cross that border on his bike. The guy is sitting there. He is also drinking beer. The border policeman went up to the Mexican. He said, in a pleading tone. "Look, my friend," he said. "I retired." "I'm not a policeman anymore.""But it's still eating me up inside." "Whatever happened, happened," he said. "I'm not in a position to do anything about it anymore.""For God's sake," he said. "What were you smuggling in that bag?" he asked. The Mexican smiled. Do you know what he said? "Bicycles, man," he said. "Bicycles." Yes. This is a magnificent joke that summarizes the contradiction between looking and seeing. I love it so much. You look carefully, I mean, you look with full attention, but you cannot see anything. Because you are actually looking in the wrong place. They are making you look in the wrong place. Now, focusing on this Özcan Deniz and such while Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya goes home is just like looking at the bag on the Mexican's saddle and failing to see the Mexican's bicycle. Our esteemed media makes us look at the bag on the saddle. Fonzie Fatma, on the other hand, is actually the bicycle itself. Because you think it's a joke, but it's actually life itself. Now let's come to the most important issue. The Mexican's bicycle. Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya was released with house arrest. It was decided that she could not stay in prison for health reasons. If you're an opponent, it's Silivri; for Ms. Fatma, it's her own home. Very nice , indeed. He's a cancer patient. He’s been imprisoned for almost two years. The man even had surgeries while in jail . LÖSEV President Üstün Ezer even wrote a letter. LÖSEV President Üstün Ezer made a statement just last week regarding the letter Murat Çalık sent to him. He says he’s drawing attention to his severe leukemia. This is a humanitarian tragedy. The LÖSEV President says he must be tried without arrest immediately. But because Murat Çalık isn't with the AKP, his severe cancer is not accepted as a health justification. There are hundreds of such serious cases in prisons, just like Murat Çalık. There are critically ill people. If you are not with the AKP, your cancer or your child outside having cancer is not counted as a health reason. Vural Avar, for instance, right? He was a lieutenant general. He was 85 years old. He had Alzheimer's. He could barely even grasp where he was anymore. He also had Parkinson's. He was in a state where he couldn't even tend to his simplest needs. He fell and broke his ribs, but that wasn't considered a health justification . They didn't release him until he died. They let him take his last breath behind iron bars. But Ms. Fatma was released in 18 days, health issues or not, and sent home. One-sided, self-serving justice. >> Yes. >> If you're not with the AKP, even if you have cancer, even if you have Alzheimer's, even if you have Parkinson's, even if your children outside are sick with cancer from grief, it isn't accepted as a health justification.
