The attackers actually spent less time in the police station than their victims . The attackers were released from the police station before their victims. They shot at journalist Can Dündar in front of the courthouse. They let the gunman who fired the shots go. They tried to arrest Can Dündar. They turned a friend into a witness— someone who said, "Look, the Hojaefendi is the only person in the world I honor ," who said, "He is like our Prophet's companions," who said, "I am like flesh and nail with him," who said, "I am a single bullet.""Load me into the service's barrel." "Fire me wherever you want," meaning he was not just a gunman, but a bullet-journalist; they made him a witness. With his testimony, they made the Sözcü newspaper a defendant. When a prosecutor was setting up a conspiracy, they said, "A statue of him should be erected." They gave him a luxury Mercedes as an official car. When the same prosecutor tried to arrest them , they called him a traitor. When Rıza Sarraf served their interests , they called him a philanthropist. They made him a witness during the December 17-25 investigation. That same Rıza Sarraf went to the US and became a cooperating witness. He testified against them. They immediately gave him the "US hotel" treatment. They arrested an American pastor on charges of espionage. They said things like, "As long as this soul is in this body, and as long as this poor man is in this office, you cannot take that terrorist." The US President sent a letter, and they released the pastor in a hurry. They arrested a German journalist of Turkish descent on espionage charges, for example. Angela Merkel sent a message saying, " If you don't release him immediately, you won't be able to buy even a bicycle from us, let alone tanks." They released the journalist in a hurry. I just explained it. They released the bigoted murderer who burned people alive in Sivas Madımak due to health issues and out of respect for his age. And as I just mentioned, they wouldn't release 85-year-old Alzheimer's patient Vural Avar, my brother. He passed away in prison. They didn't even open an investigation into a retired general who prepared a constitution to replace the Republic of Turkey with an Islamic state, organized an international congress in Istanbul to change our official language, capital, and flag, had an armed cadre, provided ammunition, and taught irregular warfare techniques. They even seated this general at the top of the state. They didn't even answer the parliamentary questions about this general, but they detained Ataturkist retired admirals—who had no military power—and put shackles on their feet just for saying, "Please do not let the Montreux Convention be undermined." They called the Turkish Armed Forces a terrorist organization. They called Ataturkist officers terrorists. They called the Chief of General Staff the leader of a terrorist organization. But they brought a Taliban delegation, listed as international terrorists by the UN, into the country through the VIP lounge and hosted them at the Çankaya Palace. They arrested those who tweeted about our "Leader of the Century." They released the person who punched the CHP leader. Tweet, and you get arrested; throw a punch, and you go free. They handed out years of prison sentences to 12-year-old children for allegedly insulting our "Leader of the Century." Meanwhile, they released those who tried to lynch the CHP leader and those who tried to burn him alive by setting fire to the house he took refuge in. They did not touch the media hangman who broadcast from in front of a gallows and told the public he was waiting for Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu to be executed and hanged. They released the person who posed with jars of bullets as if they were pickles , saying to Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu, Özgür Özel, and Canan Kaftancıoğlu, "Behave yourselves, or you're the first ones I'll kill." Clearly threatening Ekrem İmamoğlu's life, saying, "Look, you miserable so-called İmamoğlu Ekrem, I will spill your blood and drink it." I am saying this so it goes on the record. You have the right to file a complaint however you wish. Either you learn to know your place, or I will break your neck, skin your scalp, and make a doormat out of it for my feet. I will tear you to pieces, I will kill you . They released the one who said, "I warn the person I'm going to kill in advance ." They released the one who explicitly threatened Canan Kaftancıoğlu with death , saying, "The Bosphorus is cool in this season, and deep in the summer." But at the same time, they launched an investigation into Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu for saying, "I have concerns about political murders in Turkey." They detained the young people who posted 'No' posters during the referendum. They reported the young people singing ' No' songs on the ferry to the prosecutor's office. They arrested the young people who tweeted 'No' for insulting the President . Simultaneously, they didn't touch the pro-government theologian who said, " Those who say 'No' are devils." They called the setups in the Ergenekon and Balyoz trials the truth. But in the Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality election, they accepted three of the four votes we put in the same envelope and dropped into the same ballot box as valid, while calling one fake. For example, what did Sedat Peker talk about? We remember, don't we? The dark oligarchs swarming Turkey, the global money launderers adding to the country's wealth, the imported mafia granted citizenship, the assassinations swept under the rug, the drug ships traveling from South America like city line ferries, cocaine barons, narcotics marinas, seized hotels, illegal betting casino owners, gamblers, dirty politicians, bribery-taking bureaucrats , blackmail tapes, fuel smuggling, arms trade, bagman journalists...Oh, what things he talked about! He told it name by name, document by document, with witnesses. Well, they didn't touch any of them. They filed a lawsuit against Sedat Peker for telling these. Singer Gülşen, for instance, was arrested for making a joke about religious high schools. Bennu Gerede, they detained Bennu Gerede because of a vibrator necklace. Even though we have been using proverbs with animals since the existence of Turkish, they put journalist Sedef Kabaş in jail for sharing a proverb with an animal, but they showed tolerance to the AKP municipal council member who said, " Pimps are Kemalists." Black humor stand-up comedian, for example, Deniz Göktaş, right? They put Deniz Göktaş in jail for insulting society's values, but they accepted the AKP Youth Branch president's words as freedom of expression when he said about Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, "No one should call him a Turk, he doesn't look like a Turk, his original is Greek." The list goes on and on. Justice that cuts only for itself. So, in this situation, is it a surprise that 'Fonzi' Fatma was sent home? Look, before Ms. Fatma, we had the Ms. Ruhsar experience, for example, right? Ruhsar Pekcan was the Minister of Trade . It turned out she bought millions of liras worth of disinfectant for the Ministry of Trade, where she was minister, from her husband's company. Moreover, it was understood that she bought it four times more expensive than the market price. I mean, we had seen many scandals, but we witnessed one like this for the first time. What happened? She didn't even resign. They saw that even those who voted for the AKP were rebelling. Five days later , she was forced to be removed from duty . During the AKP era, they even managed to dirty the disinfectant, my brother. Is it a surprise that 'Fonzi' Fatma was sent home? We had the Zehra Taşkesenlioğlu experience, for example, in this country . Who was her brother? He was someone who had worked as an executive for 16 years at the sect's bank, Bankasya. Despite this, he had been brought to the head of the Capital Markets Board (SPK). Her sister Zehra was also made an AKP MP . Just like 'Fonzi' Fatma, she was saying she lived a modest life. What was she saying? She was saying things like, "I am an individual who strives to take the 6666 verses as the touchstone of my life," right? Suddenly it turned out they had a $ 4.5 million yacht. It turned out they had a copper mine in Africa. Her husband, whom the AKP made a rector , fled the country in a snap, despite supposedly being under a travel ban, after it was revealed he was involved in stock market manipulation. What happened, for instance, with the Zehra Hanım affair? Silence. What would have happened if Zehra Hanım had been from the CHP or a new party? Wouldn't the justice that seems to have gone dormant have been activated? We experienced the December 17-25 events in this country, for example. The religious union between the AKP and the Fethullah Gülen community had been broken. They used to say, "We walked these paths together for years," but the roads they walked together toward the same destination had split, and the December 17-25 sewage system had burst. Bundles of dollars stuffed into shoeboxes, oversized safes in bedrooms, money counting machines, and chocolate packages filled with cash handed out like gifts—the chocolate, the chocolate packages—were all strewn about. Minister of Economy Zafer Çağlayan, Interior Minister Muammer Güler, and Urbanization Minister Erdoğan Bayraktar were forced to resign. Egemen Bağış was also removed from his ministry. It was said, for instance, that Rıza Sarraf had gifted Minister of Economy Zafer Çağlayan a Patek Philippe watch worth 463,000 Swiss francs, right? It was written in the indictment. But what were they saying to defend these things? For example, what did AKP deputy Metin Külünk say? He said December 17 was an interference with people's freedom to commit sins. He claimed it was an interference with God's boundaries, you know. What did another deputy, Burhan Kuzu, say? Even if the voice recordings on the internet are true, no one believes them . He said the nation is perfectly satisfied. What did the AKP's theologian Hayrettin Karaman say, for example? Corruption is one thing, theft is another. The guy was literally saying it is a religious slander to call corruption theft. What did the veiled writer Emine Şenlikoğlu say, for example? She said religious people might have given their zakat to the prime minister to distribute to the poor. She was saying it could only be that. What did the Halkbank General Manager say, who was caught with bundles of dollars in shoeboxes in his library? He said that money was for building an imam-hatip school. He claimed they were donations made to be a bridge for good deeds. What did the AKP's wise man, Etyen Mahçupyan, say while defending these? He said corruption isn't just empty talk, but the AKP voter made a rational choice . What did another AKP wise man, Abdurrahman Dilipak, say? He said I’m not saying there is no corruption, but the people realized the dirty game. They stood by the AK Party. He used to say, "With greetings and prayers," you know. How was Muammer Güler defending himself ? How did he describe the 6 oversized safes in his son's bedroom? He says my son is a bit stingy. He claims he moved the safes to his house when he closed his workplace. How was Minister of Economy Zafer Çağlayan defending himself? He says they are disturbed by Turkey's rise. He says they are trying to stop us from building a spaceship. A commission was established in the Grand National Assembly of Turkey regarding whether these aforementioned ministers should be tried at the Supreme Council. There were 9 AKP members, 4 CHP members , and 1 MHP member. The voting took place. Since the majority was naturally held by the AKP, the decision was made that they should not go to the Supreme Council. All 9 AKP deputies on the commission had said there was no crime or anything of the sort. Look, especially you young people, I am telling you this name by name so it remains in your digital archives. I am telling you this by underlining it . They asked AKP Denizli Deputy Bilal Uçar . He said they might have committed criminal acts, but there is no evidence . The man said there is no evidence. They asked AKP Yozgat Deputy Yusuf Başer . He said these are all perception operations. He said there was no evidence or anything. They asked AKP Aksaray Deputy İlknur İnceöz. She said any person with a sound mind and clear judgment can see this is a fabrication. She said there was no evidence or anything. They asked AKP Kastamonu Deputy Hakkı Köylü. No crime was found. He said there was no evidence or anything here. They asked AKP Bursa Deputy Kemal Şerbetçioğlu. No trace of a crime could be seen. He said there was no evidence or anything here. They asked AKP Bursa Deputy İsmet Su. There is no crime and no evidence. He said if we say there is a crime, we would be supporting the coup. What a coup-monger. They asked AKP Bartın Deputy Yılmaz Tunç . He said there was no crime or anything , no evidence. They asked AKP Konya Deputy Mustafa Akış . He said it is very striking that the commission of the crime was not prevented. He stated it is significant and striking that no intervention was made regarding the money alleged to be bribes sent to ministers. The guy actually said, "If it was sent as a bribe, why didn't you catch them on the way?" They asked AKP Konya Deputy Ayşe Türkmenoğlu. She gave the most brilliant explanation . She said: "Even if we assume our ministers confessed to everything, no reasonable suspicion was formed in my mind that they committed a crime." It's mind-boggling. I mean, she said even if the ministers confessed that they took everything, such a suspicion didn't form in her mind . That’s how they went down in history. The December 17-25 probe was swept under the rug. The AKP ministers got off scot-free. Bartın Deputy Yılmaz Tunç, who cleared the ministers by saying there was no crime or evidence, became the Minister of Justice of the Republic of Turkey in 2023. So, is it strange that "Fund-Manager" Fatma Hanım was sent home in 18 days? That is "one-sided" justice. Look, especially young people, please listen carefully. The 2.5 million euros and 2.5 million dollars stacked in shoeboxes by the Halkbank General Manager had been seized . It was paid back to him in a heartbeat. And they even paid interest for the days it was kept in custody. They paid the money back with interest. There was the man of the "charitable" Rıza Sarraf. He had been caught with 1 million euros and 2 kilos of gold. All of it was returned to him. And as with the other one, they paid interest for the days it was held in custody. They paid interest to the "charitable" Rıza, interest! Rıza Sarraf was a well-known " charitable" businessman. His man was also a philanthropist, just like his boss. He donated the interest income to the Red Crescent. He even made the donation from a Halkbank branch. All that remained in the state's hands were two money-counting machines, empty shoeboxes, and two bath loofahs, yes. Because dollars were stuffed not only into shoeboxes but also into bath loofahs. The empty shoeboxes and bath loofahs were thrown in the trash. The money-counting machines handed over to judicial custody were sent to the National Real Estate Directorate. They were sold through an auction method . 200 liras of revenue was generated, yes. Only 200 liras. This magnificent income was also transferred to our state treasury. Therefore, let me tell you, we should be grateful that "Fund-Manager" Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya was sent home in just 18 days . Because with this one-sided justice, they could even return the 2 billion liras that Fatma Hanım returned to the treasury back to her with interest. So let's be grateful she was released. We experienced the Erdoğan Bayraktar situation, for example, in this country . In the December 17-25 affair, the Minister of Urban Planning, Erdoğan Bayraktar, was forced to resign. Years later, in 2021, the man gave an interview to the media. He made some frank confessions. He said , "The boss put me in the bag with the thieves." "The boss, our Honorable President, put me in the bag with the thieves," he said . I don't know Rıza Sarraf. There was no theft in my file. The recordings were authentic. Every bit of them from A to Z was true. But no money was found on me. He said, "When my leader put me in the same bag with the other ministers, you portray me as a thief too." I wanted to distance myself, but I wasn't strong enough. They'd beat me, kill me, or do who knows what, he said. He said, "When my leader put me in that same bag of thieves, you cast me as a thief along with the four ministers." I didn't resign from the ministry; they fired me. While I was performing my ministerial duties, they put me in the bag of thieves and fired me. He said he was resentful. He literally used those exact words, " bag of thieves." What would have happened if Erdoğan Bayraktar, who said these things, had been from the CHP or a new party? By the way, look, according to the principle of equality in the Constitution, we must examine the opposition just as we examine the government. Isn't that right? The Constitution includes an equality clause . During the 17-25 December period—young people, mark my words—during the 17-25 December era, who was one of the most active CHP deputies, the one who most closely followed the corruption allegations against the government? It was Umut Oran, whom we are proud to have among us. A CHP deputy. He would take the stand in the Grand National Assembly of Turkey with documents and file parliamentary questions. That is why he became one of the deputies the government hated most. He was being lynched by pro-government media with baseless slanders. He was even accused of things like assassination. Look, because he was pressuring the government, they were opening investigations against him. He had parliamentary immunity. So, what happened in the end? Young people, note this: Umut Oran, the deputy who followed 17-25 December most closely on behalf of the CHP and the people, was purged from the CHP by Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu himself. Yes. He was never made a deputy again. His parliamentary immunity was stripped away. He was left all alone and unprotected. Umut Oran had to struggle with these slander lawsuits all by himself for years. Those hired puppets in the so-called opposition media who took money for this —those scoundrels—mark my words, they never once reported on this event. Yes. Umut Oran was left all alone and unprotected by Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu once his parliamentary immunity was gone. He was tried alone for years. These hired puppets in the so-called opposition media didn't write a single line about it. In the end, he won in court, of course, but yet another CHP deputy highly respected by Atatürkist voters was cast out of his home. Umut Oran wasn't the only one purged from the CHP over the 17-25 December affair. Look at CHP deputy Ali Özgündüz , for example. Ali Özgündüz. A former prosecutor. An honest man. Because he was a prosecutor, he scrutinized the dossiers on Zafer Çağlayan and Muammer Güler with a prosecutor's precision and announced them to the public. We, as journalists, followed them and learned the facts. He was one of the deputies who made the AKP the most uncomfortable. What was done to him? He was crossed off by the Kılıçdaroğlu administration. He wasn't made a deputy again, friend. Ali Özgündüz. Yes. CHP deputy Atilla Kart, for example. He was one of the first names that came to mind in Turkey when you mentioned the fight against corruption. With his legal expertise, he scrutinized the 17-25 December events in great detail. He filed criminal complaints. What was done to him? The same thing was done. They were crossed off by the Kılıçdaroğlu administration. They were never made members of parliament again. Look, when the parliamentary commission was established to investigate the December 17-25 corruption scandal, who represented the CHP? Rıza Türmen, Erdal Aksünger, and Osman Korutürk represented it. Rıza Türmen was an extremely important figure regarding the world's perspective on this case, as he had served as a judge at the European Court of Human Rights for 10 years. Erdal Aksünger was an IT expert. Since the 17-25 case consisted of digital data, Twitter, and YouTube, he was a very, very important figure in terms of expert opinion. Osman Korutürk was an ambassador. With his diplomatic credentials, he was a very, very important figure regarding the world's perspective on this case. Look, when the Cuckoo operation began, the CHP had such important cadres. What was done? Rıza Türmen, Erdal Aksünger, and Osman Korutürk, who had not the slightest blemish in their private lives or careers, were—just like Umut Oran, just like Ali Özgündüz, just like Atilla Kart —never made members of parliament again . They were crossed off by the Kılıçdaroğlu administration and purged. While everyone was looking at the AKP, the CHP was actually being reset. Yes. The true children of the CHP were being kicked out of the party under the guise of opportunity. In their place, people who had nothing to do with the CHP were brought in. The Cuckoo operation was working like clockwork. Now, Kılıçdaroğlu, who talks about cleansing and such today, destroyed the honest CHP deputies who questioned the December 17-25 scandal. Those who exposed Kılıçdaroğlu's actions were smeared by the so-called opposition media hired with money. For my part, for example, I was declared a secret AKP supporter because I explained the Cuckoo operation. I went through everything imaginable. For years, they targeted me with lies in front of CHP voters. While the true children of the CHP— respected deputies like Umut Oran, Ali Özgündüz, and Atilla Kart, and distinguished and competent deputies like Rıza Türmen, Erdal Aksünger, and Osman Korutürk—were being kicked out by the CHP immediately after the December 17-25 period, where were those who are currently founding the new party, especially Özgür Özel, and these female mayors who have now switched to the AKP? They were all Kılıçdaroğlu's right-hand men. All of them had been made members of parliament by Kılıçdaroğlu. While the true children of the CHP were being thrown out of the nest, these people were being planted into the CHP's nest as cuckoo eggs. Therefore, we need to ask this within the framework of the equality principle in the constitution. Can those who purged honest deputies from the CHP during the December 17-25 period hold "Fonzi" Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya accountable today? Who are you fooling, brother? When there is a government that acts only in its own interest and an opposition that acts like it's just an opposition, no one should be offended. We should be thankful that "Fonzi" Fatma was sent home in just 18 days. We should be thankful that they didn't return her 2 billion lira with interest . That is all for today. Please don't forget to subscribe, like, comment, and share. The world's biggest family. Thanks to you, thanks to your support, we are able to do independent journalism . Otherwise, they would have long since wiped us out of the profession. I can never repay what I owe you. I thank you all from the bottom of my heart. I will hold a raffle among my subscribers. I will gift four lucky viewers a health report to be used in case of any arrest . Yes. Since I am a secret AKP supporter, I have acquaintances in the said government. I have friends in the Palace and such. My cousin is there and so on. I've arranged excellent health reports. You will be home in 18 days at the latest. I will not include non-subscribers in the raffle. Don't bother with gifts like health reports. Go to the nearest hardware store. Buy yourself an adze. If you get in a tight spot, you can carve your own way out. I wish you all a healthy, peaceful, and if possible, a happy weekend. See you Tuesday morning. Cheers.

items.title: Irak’ta Kürt federasyonu dağılıyor mu? Türkiye’deki süreci nasıl etkiliyor?
items.transkript: Hello. I send my regards to all of you and wish you a pleasant day. Regarding the fund crisis, there's a new development: the Treasury and Finance Minister Mehmet Şimşek has granted permission for an investigation into Şahap Kavcıoğlu, the head of the Banking Regulation and Supervision Board. The request for this investigation was made by the Istanbul Chief Public Prosecutor's Office, as you know, but truly significant developments are expected these days. Now I want to touch upon important developments in another area. It's not often mentioned. Yet, you know how there's this issue of a Turkey without terrorism, the stance of the new party, the DEM Party, its contacts–I'll go into details shortly– but when we look up, we can see that what's happening in Iraq could greatly affect the process in Türkiye. What's happening? In Iraq, as you know, after the American invasion, something remaining from the 1964 Constitution was revived, and a Kurdish Federation was established. The center of this Kurdish Federation is Erbil, known as the Kurdistan Regional Government of Iraq. Recent developments, especially those that have accelerated in the last few weeks, have raised big questions about the future of this Kurdish Federation. Because on one hand there's the Kurdistan Democratic Party, on the other hand the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan, one controlled by the Barzani family and tribe, and the other by the Talabani family. They have major problems with each other and with the central government in Baghdad. I'll go into detail about that now, but the main issue that concerns us here is , of course, the PKK issue. No one is talking about the PKK laying down its arms anymore. There's talk of withdrawal and so on. There's talk of whether this will have a slowing effect on the process. The National Security Council met, as you know. The National Security Council meeting ...these developments within the framework of the National Security Council are continuing. Then, a meeting of that council, chaired by Vice President Cevdet Yılmaz, is foreseen. Of course, the question is whether Abdullah Öcalan, the PKK leader, will be given a status or not. What did the DEM Party delegation say after their last visit? Well, coordination, a coordinator. They've been saying that from the beginning. They were very pleased that a separate place had been established, a secretariat had been formed, and so on. They were very pleased, but they want this status to be granted as soon as possible. Of course, the state and its powers are also saying to the DEM Party, "Okay, you always ask us for things, but you should also, even half-heartedly, make a call to the PKK, do something." Because, for example, recently, a Nationalist Movement Party (MHP) MP received very harsh reactions from the nationalist circles in Trabzon while giving a speech. He even had to finish his speech with a slightly trembling voice. So, on the one hand, the Nationalist Movement Party is trying to explain to its own constituency that this will be good for Turkey, saying, "Okay, I've put my hand in the fire." But according to public opinion polls, 65-70%of the public doesn't believe the PKK will lay down its arms. There are such realities. And on the other hand, there's the new party's stance. They're saying they won't provide members to the commission, and there's a key date there, friends. On November 30th, Parliament Speaker Numan Kurtulmuş announced how many members each party would receive based on their number of seats in parliament, and said he was expecting names by the 30th. This also refers to Özgür Özel's earlier statement that they wouldn't provide members to the commission unless democratic conditions and steps were taken. Kurtulmuş's response was something like , "I haven't received anything in writing yet, I'll see what I do," and that's the November 30th deadline. There aren't many days left until then. Could some easing measures be taken during this process? For example, regarding the appointment of trustees to municipalities, similar things, the implementation of Constitutional Court decisions, and the issue of prisoners, for instance, the DEVA Party's request for the release of sick prisoners, which Özgür Özel also mentioned. There's already uncertainty within the system. Look, the DEVA Party delegation , the İmralı delegation, met with the Minister of Justice Akın Gürlek yesterday. The main topic of discussion was the release and pardon of these sick prisoners, the reversal of executions, and so on, but today they also met with the leader of the Nationalist Movement Party, Devlet Bahçeli. My insider information suggests they also want to meet with Özgür Özel. That will likely happen as well. By the way, two parties have already responded to Numan Kurtulmuş's call by appointing members. The Nationalist Movement Party has announced two members, and the Republican People's Party has announced one. Therefore, they are already participating in the commission, which is something that further angers Özgür Özel. He repeatedly said things like, "You have a [referring to a specific political party], let them be your opposition," in his parliamentary group speech last Tuesday. Of course, that tension–the tension between the New Party and the Republican People's Party, the tension under Kılıçdaroğlu's leadership–is spilling over into other areas, as we see. It's spilling over into this area, but I want to digress. I will also come to the developments in Iraq, the conflict between the Kurdistan Democratic Party of the Barzani family and the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan of Kurdistan (PUK), I apologize, the Kurdistan Patriotic Union of Kurdistan, of the Talabani family. And the contradiction in Baghdad is that there are PKK members, and I'm referring to some of this based on what's been reflected in open sources. There are already those inside who don't believe in this process. There are still those inside who have one eye on Iran and one eye on Israel, saying things like, "If Israel takes advantage of this vacuum, would we have committed to laying down arms for nothing?" Now, there are those who say, "Why are we laying down arms in Iraq when the future of the Kurdistan Regional Government is already in danger? While they are weakened, we can take over these areas as they are." Therefore, the developments there affect the speed of the process in Türkiye. So, when we look at it, we only see the question of why the government isn't taking an extra step. But what was the law from the beginning ? The laying down of arms was to be confirmed by the National Security Council, right? We haven't reached that stage yet. The statements made now, the statements made by security officials, were made in October, saying that four regions were evacuated by PKK members. After that, recently, 14 more camp areas were evacuated, in regions near the Turkish border such as Metina, Hakurk, and Zap. But there's no mention of laying down arms. Only withdrawals, like 40 km, 60 km, etc. But wasn't laying down arms the main issue? That's not addressed. That topic isn't mentioned. Yet, this really delays the whole process and causes democracy in Türkiye to stagnate, to slide backwards, whether it's media freedom, freedom of expression in the press, or the operations against municipalities–don't make me list them all, you understand. There's the non-implementation of Constitutional Court decisions, and so on. While there's regression on one hand, on the other hand, the government and the DEM Party say, "Let's solve this issue, a Turkey without terrorism, reconciliation with the PKK, its dissolution, etc., and democracy will be a part of it." But there's a situation here where they're constantly hindering each other instead of developing each other. Or, it's possible to say this: The democratization problems currently being raised by the New Party, by Özgür Özel, are significant problems. On the other hand, the disarmament of the PKK and its integration into politics is a strategic step for Turkey . It's a strategic step beyond daily political injustices and unfairness. It also concerns Türkiye's relations with the region. Therefore, small steps taken by the government in the area of democratization will likely lead the New Party to reconsider its decision. But as I said, there are developments in Iraq. Let me go into a little more detail. What is the problem? Something happened. Elections were held in the Iraqi Kurdistan Regional Government, and in these elections, the Kurdistan Democratic Party gained the majority. It's under the control of the Barzani family. Until then, until these elections, the administrative bodies within the Iraqi Kurdistan Regional Government, the federal structure–whether it's security , law enforcement, education, or other administrative structures–were 50/50. The Americans dictated this. Remember how they drafted a constitution in 2007 during the occupation, leaving it at 50/50? But now, in the parliament, in the federal parliament—and I say federal parliament, but in the regional parliament, the Kurdistan regional parliament—the KDP has a clear majority . They say, "Look, you can't get enough votes. Why? How do you still want half of the vote?" Problems arise again over oil revenues. Problems arise over border security. Onu da Aralık'ta Fed halledecek. faiz arttırmaya başlayacak ve faiz arttırımları devam edecek. Bir veri geldi Amerika'dan. Akıllara durgunluk verecek bir veri. 3ünc çeyrek büyüme 3.4'ten 4.3'e revize edildi. Ama mesele o değil. Fed'in ve bizim gibi usta ekonomistlerin daha yakından takip ettiği net iç satışlar diye bir veri var. Bu dışarıdan gelen ithalat, ihracat farkını ve bazı başka verideki oynaklığı tamamen atarak eee o ülkenin içindeki insanların ne kadar çıktı, ürettiğine ve tükettiğine bakıyor. O 5.3. Çok güzel. Bu Türkiye için tamam ya hedef de denebilir ama değil. hedefin neredeyse %70 üstünde. >> Dolayısıyla 1 değil 2 3 belki 4 faiz arttırımı gerekecek. İşte bu henüz Wall Street'te satılmıyor. Yani fon yöneticisi yapay zekadan çıkıyor gidiyor tıbbi malzeme alıyor, sağlık sektörü alıyor, banka alıyor, şu alıyor, bu alıyor. Ama bunların da bir şeyi yok. Geçerliliği yok. Yani Fed'in 4 defa faiz arttırması, uluslararı piyasanın biraz daha >> tab >> düşmesi yani TL mevduat hariç hiçbir piyasada hayat yok. Ben söyleyeyim çok açıkçası. Ben 10.000 puan dedim insanlar güldü. Gidiyoruz oraya doğru yavaş yavaş. Belki onun da altına düşebiliriz. >> Altın >> ya altın düşmeye devam eder. Bu bahsettiğim senaryoda çok umut verici değil. Düştükçe de ben alırım. Bireysel olarak değil fonya açıcısı olsam yani Warren Buffett eminim şu anda altın alırdı. Mark Mobius hayatta olsaydı altın alırdı. Çünkü merkez bankaları altın almaya devam edecekler. Yani bir talepte bir taban var. Onun altına düşmüyor. Ve üstelik Türkiye, Hindistan, Arap ülkeleri, Çin gibi geleneksel olarak yalnız sikke değil takı olarak da altına çok meraklı ülkeler var. Bu ülkelerde çok ciddi bir talep artışı yaşayacağız. Türkiye'de düğünler hızlanacak >> artık. Evet, konuşacağız piyasalarla daha çok işimiz bu zaten. Ama yavaş yavaş sonuna geldik. Su gibi aktı ya. >> Birkaç tane önemli haber var. Onlarla ilgili görüşünüzü almak istiyoruz. Birincisi Şahap Kavcıoğlu'nda soruşturma izni verildi. Hazine ve Maliye Bakanı tarafından Mehmet Şimşek tarafından uzun zamandır bekliyordu. Fon konusunu konuşacaklar. >> Orada iki tane senaryo var. Birisi çok iyimser ve bence piyasaya kısa vadeli de olsa çok ciddi alım getirir. O daha önce de iddia ettiğim gibi Sayın Erdoğan eee havlu atacak ve diyecek ki herkesi biz bütçeden ödeyeceğiz. Bu düşük bir ihtimal. İkincisi insanlara açık açık ana paraların dahi geri alamayacakları söylenecek. Belki ileride iade fonunda yeteri kadar para birikirse ek ödeme yapılabileceği söylenecek. Ama diğer 5 milyon borsa yatırımcısı ve toplumda bu konuyu takip edenlerin bu konuya vakıf olduğuna emin değil. Çünkü 1 milyon liraya kadar ödeme yapılacak deniyor. Aslında cümle yanlış kuruluyor. Bu çok ciddi bir sıkıntı yaratacak ve bu sıkıntı eee toplumun siyasi olarak şey Evet. yani toplumun siyasi bağlantıların araştırılması talebini yükseltecek. Sayın Şahap Kavcıoğlu işte bu konuyla ilişkili olabilecek bir kişi konumundan şüpheli konumuna yükseltildi. Hayati Yazıcıoğlu ben bildiğim kadarıyla AKP'nin kurucularından Sayın Erdoğan'ın yanında kalan tek şahsiyet istifa etmek zorunda kaldı. Ve bunlar daha başlangıç. Daha önce >> başlangıç mı bitiş mi? >> Başlangıç. Ahmet Hakan söyledi. Ben değil. Daha neler geleceğiz? Başlangıç başlıyor mu bitiyor mu? İşte bu böyledir ama yani generaller de hep bu sıkıntıyla karşı karşıya kalırlar. Geri çekileceksen bir miktar askeri geride bırakıp düşmanın ilerlemesini yavaşlatacaksın. Çok acı bir şey. Kahraman askerler, zavallı gençler şehit olur ama ordunun büyük kısmını kurtarırsın. Burada da ordunun büyük kısmı malum şahsiyetler. Onun da ötesinde seçim kazanma potansiyeli. Çünkü yani Genar Asal gibi AKP'ye yakın olduğu iddia edilen anket şirketleri bile Eylüld'den bu yana AKP'nin 3 ila 5 puan oy kaybettiğini söylüyor. Bir de hangi gazeteciler katılacak, izin verecek. >> Evet. >> Onlar da bakacağız ama önemli bir toplantı. Önemli bir basın toplantısı. Bak >> bence yani >> bence bir şey çıkmayacak. >> Efendim >> büyük bir şey çıkmayacak. >> Büyük bir şey çıkmayacak ama şu ihtimalde dışarıda bırakmıyorum dediğim gibi. Yani aklın yolu birdir. Bütçeden ödeme yapılması lazım. Zaten >> aklın yolu bir değil. Şöyle bir değil. Genel kanı sizin genel akı sizin söylediğinizin tersi ama onu söyleyeyim. Ya akı değil mi onlar? Bo yakmayım. Hayır yok şunu söylemeye çalışıyorum yani tutarlı olalım. HGS'den ne kadar kazık yedik? Kimse tartışıyor mu? Tartışması gerekiyor. İkincisi bütçeden bütün bu imtiyazlı karayollarında tellere filan ne kadar ödeme yapılıyor? Bu vergi mükellefinin cebinden çıkmıyor mu? Bunun sorulması lazım. Yani eğer vergi mükellefinin cebinden para çıkmayacaksa buna kesinlikle karşıysak bütün bu delikleri kapatalım ya da bu saçmalığı bir kenara bırakalım. En azından siyasi açıdan bırakalım. 10 yıldır bütçe rakamlarına dahi bakmayan bir muhalif vatandaşın birden derenip aa fon vurgununda zadelere benim cebimden mi ödeyeceksiniz demesi kadar saçma bir şey olamaz. Çünkü zaten her gün yapılıyor bu. müteahitlerden imtiyaz sahiplerine kadar ve gördüğümüz gibi bazı AKP yakın bürokratların hatta parti üyelerinin yakınlarına yapıldığı gibi bütçeden Ulife dağıtılıyor. Ağzını açmamışsın şimdiye kadar. Şu öyle bir önünde öyle bir kriz var ki bütün siyasal dengeleri değiştirebilir. Şimdi konuşuyorsun. Ben anlamıyorum bunu. Yani Murat Yetkin de izledim. Atilla Bey diyor ki bu fon ekibi, fon vurgunu yapan ekip bir yerden birin iddiası bu. Paylaşmış. 19 Mart'ta İmamoğlu'nun gözaltına arı tutuklanma sürecinde önceden haber adımı ona göre pozisyon. Şimdi şöyle bir şey var. Bu ekip bu kadar güçlüyse ki güçlü aşka Türkiye'nin son 5-6 senesinde finansal piyasadaki çok büyük hareketlerde önceden bilgi almadığı, pozisyon alıp armadı. KKM var burada işte 19 Mart var, yerel seçim var. faiz bir sürü yani 78 tane majör şey sayabiliriz. Hayır hepsinin sorgulanması lazım çünkü hepsinde elde eden para belki bu 20 milyarı bile gerde bırakabilir gün sonra >> KKM'de önceden bilenler akıl almaz paralar kazandı. Bir gecede dolar bazında %4 kazandı. >> Eee ondan önce Verat Albayrağı 128 milyarı onun ne kadarı yerli yatırımcının cebine gitti ve kimlerin cebinde gitti? Bak bir kere daha görüyor musun? İşte bu maalesef Türk insanının tutarsızlığı. Bütün bunların hepsi aslında bütçeden ve bizim cebimizden çıktı. >> Fark etti. Evet. >> Fark etmedik. Şimdi hesap soruyoruz. Çok geç olmuş artık. Son olarak daha geniş çarpı konuşacağız ama haber çok diye soruyorum. Made in Europe sürekli haber akışı var ve özellikle Türkiye'deki iş insanları, sanayiciler bu konuda uyarı yapıyor. İşte yapmamız, bir şey yapmamız yani burada ne diyeyim daha kalıcı bir sorunla karşı karşıya kalmak üzereyiz. Kısaca made inan Europe'daki yorumunuz. İlgen bölümlerde daha detay. Europa bir yıl var. Şu anda bu sadece konsey düzeyinde tartışılıyor ve ülkeler arasında. Ama bunun pişirilip Avrupa Parlamentosu ve Bakanlar Konseyi ya da liderler konseyinden geçmesi zaman alır. Ondan sonra da muhtemelen yalnız Türkiye değil bunun dışında bırakılan İngiltere işte Avrupa'nın özel anlaşması olan ama Made Europa dahil edilmeyen ülkelerin hepsi Dünya Ticaret Örgütüe dava açacaklar. Ama her halükarda benim düşüncemin aksine bu gerçek. Yani şunu söyleyeyim. Made in Europe Avrupa'yı öldürecek bir şey. Biz Avrupa'ya yalnız araba satmıyoruz. >> Tabii >> araba parçaları da satıyoruz. Yani tedarik zinciri entegre olmuş. Bizim savunma ürünlerimiz olmadan Rusya ile savaştan bahsediyorlar. Bir savunma sanayileri yok. Bu son derece büyük bir aptallık. Ama eğer benim söylediklerimin hepsi yanlış da böyle bir şey olursa gümrük birliği sorgulanır. Yani Türkiye gümrük birliğinden çıkma tehdidini masaya koyabilir. >> Ama burada Türkiye de çok büyük kaybeder. >> Hayır ama zaten senin gümrük birliğiyle elde ettiğini düşündüğün bütün imtiyazları senden geri alıyorlar. Yani sen gümrük birliğiyle siyasi değil ama ekonomik olarak sanayide Avrupa'dan farksız muamele görme sözü almıştın. Şimdi adam senin en çok ihracat yaptığın alanlarda seni duvarın karşısına arkasına koyuyor. E bu ama işte bu yani o yüzden Dünya Ticaret Örgütüne gidilecek zaten. E bu doğru bir şey değil ki. Senin ne avantajın kaldı? Zaten çok büyük kazığı şeyden yedik. Yani Avrupa, Meksika'yla, Güney Kore'yile şununla bununla ticaret anlaşmaları imzaladı. >> Bunlar bize uygulanmıyor. Yani biz o adamların malını bedavaya almak zorundayız ama biz Güney Kore'ye gümrüksüz mal satamıyoruz. Dolayısıyla bu tartışma bir ara gündemde olmuştu. Bu sefer iş dünyasının da ben ya bu iş böyle olmayacak başka türlü düşünelim dediğini zannediyorum. Sebebi de şu. O zamandan beri ortalama tarife yani vergi zaten çok düştü. Neyse uzatmay >> uzatmayalım ama konuşacağız. Bu bugün esniyor esniyorsun filan. >> Yok esnemek değil de bugün konusu değil o yüzden sonra rahat rahat konuşuruz. Kaç dakika oldu? >> 55 dakika. >> 35 dakikada konuşuyorsunuz. Batıya Bey >> daha yeni başlıyorum ya. Daha açılış şey dün 42 dakika aralıksız yapay zeka anlattım. Ne söylediğimi hatırlamıyorum. Üniversite en fark görüşmek üzere. Soyun yayın daha kesmedik >> ha. Tamam. >> Soyun neye gidiyorsunuz ya? Soyunup diş mi çektireceğim abi? Anlamıyorsun sen. Benim soru şu anda benim en büyük sorunum diş ve şükran günü yemeği. Domuz butu şeyde fırında. >> Fırında mı? >> Kim? Üstüne bal sürdün değil mi? Domuz butunu. >> Afiyet olsun. Tekrar şükran gününüzü kutluyoruz ve geçmiş olsun diyoruz. >> Allah rahmet eylesin. >> Pazartesi günü görüşmek üzere. Ah man.
